propositions: Extract cohesive identity transition rules (bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, numeric-ID re-key) from BindingStore into a new BindingLifecycle class while preserving all existing behavior and public facade signatures.
Every bind/confirm/unbind transition must leave at most one forward entry and one matching reverse entry, enforced by targeted single-key pops with no ambiguity detection or abort.
bind_confirm performs last-writer-wins on the forward entry and pops exactly one differing old reverse key with no sweep, no ambiguity detection, and no abort.
Numeric-ID re-key moves issues by updating jira_key and resetting absent_404_count instead of retiring them, only when a different current key exists.
Stale reverse entries are removed only in four permitted cases: bind_confirm rebind, unbind with sweep, numeric-ID re-key, and _retire.

note_absent_or_rekey remains on the facade as coordinator; only the re-key mutation (step 4: identity comparison and key swap) moves to BindingLifecycle.rekey, returning False to defer absence handling to S2 T2.
